offering_description.value: Operates aesthetic and cosmetic surgery clinics in Japan that sell procedures to individual patients who pay for their own treatment. It also serves international patients who travel to Japan for care.

primary_services.value: cosmetic surgery; aesthetic medical treatments; consultations; medical tourism support

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual patients seeking cosmetic surgery and aesthetic treatments, including international patients

revenue_model.value: service fees: patients pay for procedures and treatments at the clinics

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs clinics that deliver cosmetic procedures directly to patients

geography_served.value: global: clinics in Japan, with patients from other countries travelling to Japan for treatment

specialization.value: related lines: cosmetic surgery, aesthetic treatments and medical tourism services sharing patients and clinic network

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated aesthetic clinics; online: online consultation and appointment booking for patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical practice and surgical procedures licensed under Japanese medical and pharmaceutical rules overseen by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

notes: Exact clinic count, current service mix and international patient share are uncertain; geography reflects Japanese clinics serving foreign patients.
